name: path-template
description: An RFC 6570 template narrowed to whole path segments: an app-relative path, or an http, https or mailto address, whose variables are path segments written exactly {name}, each name matching ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ and named once. An absolute URL's authority, a query and a fragment hold no variable, and a brace anywhere else is refused.
